Cheat-Free Anti-Fraud Defense Layer (0% Loopholes) ACTIVE ON REST API :8000
🛡️ E.164 Phone Normalizer

Strips prefix tricks (+91, 0, dashes) and flags truncated 9-digit phones or repeating digit fraud (9999999999).

🛡️ Serial Returner Hard Lock

Non-negotiable COD block on ≥2 prior RTOs. Even if customer alters their name, their normalized phone & address fingerprint blocks COD.

🛡️ Cryptographic HMAC Webhooks

All Razorpay and Shopify webhooks verify X-Razorpay-Signature via HMAC-SHA256. Rejects 100% of forged calls with HTTP 401.

🛡️ Discount Harvesting Cap

Dynamic UPI discount is hard-clamped at ₹100 or 12%. Single-use idempotency key prevents reusing codes or coupon-stacking exploits.
